description: Record one generation occurrence independently from the deduplicated output asset. Use this when an agent knows that a specific generation produced a saved GravityPort asset.

captureContextId.description: GravityPort/local observation context. This is not a provider generation-call ID. Several generations in one capture context are told apart by providerToolCallId.

outputAssetId.description: Existing GravityPort asset produced by this generation.

providerGenerationCallId.description: Provider generation-call identifier only when actually supplied by the provider integration.

allowed_uses.description: Purposes this reference may serve, for example identity, style, world, wardrobe, composition. Once set, any purpose outside the list is treated as forbidden.

forbidden_uses.description: Purposes this reference must not serve. A forbidden use always overrides the same allowed use.

rights.description: Rights declarations for the reference image. Unstated fields stay unknown; silence is never recorded as permission.

verificationLevel.description: Evidence level for this externally supplied record. provider_verified is reserved for trusted GravityPort provider integrations.

name: generation_record
